title: ProcessingJobRequest v1
description: One attempt to run one logical processing job, sent by Django to a worker (lai_processing.contracts.jobs.ProcessingJobRequest). Never carries file bytes, presigned URLs, child data or credentials. The Python decoder is authoritative: it also enforces cross-field rules this schema cannot express (job-type requirements, subject/asset agreement, namespaced object keys, expires_at after submitted_at, input size within limits).

schema_version.description: Contract schema version. Readers refuse unsupported versions with unsupported_schema_version.

job_id.description: Django's job row id for this logical work (lowercase UUID).

job_type.description: A job type from the closed catalog in contracts/job_types.py (for example reference.checksum, asset.validate_model). Unknown types fail with unsupported_job_type.

namespace.description: Environment namespace (for example local, staging, prod). Quarantine and artifact keys must sit inside it.

subject.description: What the job is about, generically.

asset.description: Asset identity; required by asset job types, null otherwise.

profile.description: The immutable processing profile version that configures the job.

input.description: The input object the job reads, or null for a job without an input.

idempotency_key.description: ik1: plus the SHA-256 of the logical work (core/idempotency.py). Excludes job, attempt, correlation, timestamps and limits.

correlation_id.description: Opaque id tying logs across Django, queues and workers. Carries no meaning.

attempt_id.description: One execution attempt of the job; a retry gets a new attempt id (lowercase UUID).

attempt_number.description: 1 for the first attempt, increasing per retry (at most 100).

submitted_at.description: When Django dispatched this attempt: UTC, ISO 8601, Z suffix.

expires_at.description: After this moment the worker refuses the attempt with job_expired; null means no expiry. Must be later than submitted_at.

options.description: Fully resolved processing options (profile defaults applied by Django): snake_case keys to scalars or short scalar lists. At most 32 entries.

limits.description: Requested resource limits; the worker clamps them to its platform ceilings.

namespace.description: Lowercase hyphenated environment name, at most 32 characters.

timestamp.description: Strict UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.ffffff]Z. Offsets and naive times are refused.

subject_type.description: snake_case subject kind. Asset job types require asset_version.

subject_id.description: Subject identifier. For asset_version subjects it must equal asset.asset_version_id.

asset_id.description: Asset slug (the Asset Library's asset id rule).

asset_version_number.description: The version's sequence number within its asset (from 1).

profile_ref.description: A processing profile by id and integer version.

object_ref.description: A logical object location. Names a logical store, never a bucket or URL; adapters map (namespace, store) to physical storage.

store.description: Logical store: assets or quarantine for inputs, artifacts for outputs.

key.description: Object key: conservative characters only, no traversal, no leading or trailing slash, under the store prefix (assets/, processing/quarantine/<namespace>/, processing/artifacts/<namespace>/).

version_id.description: Exact object version where the store has one; null for the current object.

input_object.description: The job input: where it is and what it must be. The worker verifies size and SHA-256 before processing.

size_bytes.description: Exact input size in bytes; must not exceed limits.max_input_bytes.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the input bytes.

option_scalar.description: An option value: null, boolean, number, or a string of at most 256 characters without control characters.

max_input_bytes.description: Largest input object the job may read.

max_output_bytes.description: Total bytes of all artifacts the job may write.

max_execution_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget, enforced cooperatively by the engine.

max_temp_bytes.description: Bytes the job may write to its private temporary workspace.

max_artifact_count.description: Number of artifacts in one result.

max_metadata_bytes.description: Canonical JSON size of the result's metadata object.

max_message_bytes.description: Encoded size of any request, result or completion message.

complexity.description: Processor-specific named counters, e.g. {"max_vertices": 200000}. At most 32 entries.
